st: Will robots steal our jobs, or just the housework?

sec.p: DeepMind, the English artificial intelligence research lab linked to Google, is always on the ball when it comes to fortissimo stuff.

sec.t: ff.9.2 Will robots steal our jobs?
sec.p: A book that analyses automation trends and their impact on society in detail is The rise of the robots by Martin Ford (2015).

sec.t: ff.9.3 Optimism takes flight (with a basic income)
sec.p: Actually, it seems that automation itself could help with the wage stagnation we saw above.
A beautiful solution could be the example of DAWN: a Japanese café with robots as waiters. The twist? These robots are remotely controlled by people with disabilities.
